The '''''Tinta Palette''''' was a liner built by [[Tinta Lines]]. It was inspired by the ''[[Queen of Empire]]''. ''[[Tinta Blue Seven]]'' was a [[Shuttle/Legends|shuttle]] attached to it.<ref name="IJ">''[[I, Jedi]]''</ref>
